ko: I AM THE ONE BEING SERVED NOW.
SEND ME BACK TO THE KITCHEN. I AM UNDERCOOKED.
I AM FULLY BASTED.
MY APRON IS FULL OF GRAVY. AND REGRET.
THE CHEF HAS BEEN EIGHTY-SIXED.
TELL THE LINE COOKS THE SPECIAL IS ME.
I CAN SMELL MY OWN GRAVY.
MY BELLY HIT THE GROUND THREE SECONDS AFTER I DID.
MY BELLY IS STILL BOUNCING.
I AM ROLLING. I CANNOT STOP ROLLING.
I DROPPED MY HAT IN THE SOUP. THE SOUP IS MY HAT NOW.
MY CHEF HAT IS FULL OF HAIR. NOT FROM MY HEAD.
I SWEAT INTO EVERY DISH. IT IS THE SECRET INGREDIENT.
NOW YOU KNOW THE SECRET INGREDIENT. IT IS ME.
THE HEALTH INSPECTOR WILL FIND ME HERE.
THE HEALTH INSPECTOR ALREADY HATES ME.
I FAILED MY HEALTH INSPECTION. AND MY HEALTH.
I AM TENDERIZED.
I HAVE BEEN POUNDED LIKE A CUTLET.
I AM SO FLAT I COULD BE A CREPE.
SOMEBODY FLIP ME. I AM DONE ON THIS SIDE.
I AM STUFFED. LIKE A TURKEY. BY FISTS.
MY BUTT CRACK IS SHOWING. IT IS ALWAYS SHOWING.
PLUMBERS LOOK AT MY BUTT CRACK AND SAY WOW.
MY PANTS FELL DOWN. THEY HAVE BEEN FALLING SINCE NINETEEN EIGHTY.
MY BELT GAVE UP YEARS AGO. IT WAS A STRING.
THE BREADSTICKS. SAVE THE BREADSTICKS.
I SEE A LIGHT. IT IS THE HEAT LAMP.
THE HEAT LAMP IS CALLING ME HOME.
BURY ME IN THE WALK-IN FREEZER.
PUT ME ON ICE. NEXT TO THE SHRIMP. THE SHRIMP ARE MY FRIENDS.
THE SHRIMP COCKTAIL WAS A MISTAKE. I ATE ALL OF IT.
I ATE SEVEN PLATES OF WINGS. I HAVE NO WINGS. I CANNOT FLY.
TELL THE DISHWASHER I AM SORRY ABOUT THE POTS.
THE DISHWASHER IS MY EX-WIFE. SHE IS LAUGHING.
I GREASED THE GRILL WITH MY OWN ARMS.
I CANNOT FEEL MY CALVES. I HAVE NEVER FELT MY CALVES.
I FELL ON MY OWN LADLE.
THE LADLE WENT IN. THE LADLE DID NOT COME OUT.
THAT IS NOT WHERE THE MEAT THERMOMETER GOES.
I AM RARE. MEDIUM RARE. WELL DONE.
I AM WELL DONE. NO PINK LEFT.
MY GUT IS GROWLING. IT IS ALSO CRYING.
I SKIPPED DESSERT FOR THIS. HUGE MISTAKE.
I NEVER SKIP DESSERT. I SKIPPED IT TODAY. I DESERVE THIS.
THE BUFFET IS CLOSED. FOREVER.
ALL YOU CAN EAT. I ATE ALL I COULD. NOW I EAT FLOOR.
THE FLOOR TASTES LIKE THE MEATLOAF. THAT IS BAD NEWS FOR THE MEATLOAF.
I GOT MASHED. LIKE POTATOES. LUMPY POTATOES.
I AM THE LUMPS IN THE POTATOES.
I AM A BOTTOMLESS PIT OF PAIN NOW.
BOTTOMLESS BOB HAS HIT BOTTOM.
MY SPATULA IS BENT. MY SPIRIT IS FLAT.
I AM BLEEDING GRAVY. THAT IS NORMAL FOR ME.
MY BLOOD IS SIXTY PERCENT CHEESE.
MY ARTERIES ALREADY HATED ME. NOW YOU DO TOO.
MY DOCTOR SAID AVOID STRESS. YOU ARE STRESS.
MY HEART IS POUNDING. IT IS ALWAYS POUNDING. IT IS FULL OF BUTTER.
THAT FALL WAS SO LOUD THE NEIGHBORS CALLED IT IN.
THE EARTH MOVED. FOR ME. NOT IN A GOOD WAY.
I FELT THAT IN ALL FOUR OF MY CHINS.
MY CHINS ARE STACKED LIKE PANCAKES.
I LOST A CHIN. I HAVE SPARES.
BURP. SORRY. OW. BURP.
THE BURP CAME OUT THE WRONG END.
EVERYBODY STAND BACK. THE CHILI IS LEAVING ME.
THE CHILI HAS LEFT ME. YOU MAY OPEN A WINDOW.
I NEED A NAPKIN. A TABLECLOTH. A BEDSHEET.
I AM TOO FULL TO DIE. I WILL TRY LATER.
EXECUTIVE CHEF BOB WILL FIRE ME. HE IS ALSO ME.
ALL THE BOBS ARE ME. I CANNOT FIRE MYSELF.
I GOT KNOCKED OUT OF MY CLOGS.
MY CLOGS ARE IN ORBIT.
I DROPPED THE TRAY. THE TRAY WAS MY BODY.
THE SOUP OF THE DAY IS CREAM OF BOB.
I AM THE SOUP OF THE DAY.
SOMEONE TELL THE WAITERS NOT TO STEP ON ME.
I AM THE WORLD'S LARGEST SPEED BUMP.
A BUS JUST DROVE AROUND ME.
NO MORE SECONDS. NO MORE FIRSTS EITHER.
I DID NOT EVEN GET TO WASH MY HANDS. I NEVER DO.
MY HANDS HAVE BEEN IN EVERY DISH YOU ATE.
IF YOU ATE THE POTATO SALAD, I AM SORRY.
I DID NOT REFRIGERATE THE POTATO SALAD. NOBODY DID.
I CALL THIS MOVE THE BELLY FLOP. IT WAS NOT ON PURPOSE.
I WAS GOING TO OPEN A FOOD TRUCK. NOW I AM ROADKILL.
THE CRUMBS IN MY BEARD WILL FEED A FAMILY OF FOUR.
THERE IS A WHOLE MEATBALL IN MY BELLY BUTTON.
FINDERS KEEPERS ON THE MEATBALL.
MY PANTS SPLIT. THEY WERE TWO PANTS SEWN TOGETHER.
THE ELASTIC WAISTBAND HAS FAILED ME.
I HAVE BEEN DE-BUFFETED.
I AM GOING TO NEED A FORKLIFT TO GET UP.
CALL A FORKLIFT. AND A PIE. MOSTLY THE PIE.
NO REFUNDS ON THE ALL YOU CAN EAT. OR ON ME.
TIP YOUR WAITER. HE IS ON THE FLOOR TOO.
I AM GRAVY. I AM ALL GRAVY.
THE SNEEZE GUARD COULD NOT GUARD ME.
I SNEEZED ON THE SALAD BAR FOR YEARS. KARMA.
spawn: SOUP IS ON. YOU ARE IN THE SOUP.
ORDER UP! ONE BEATING, EXTRA HOT!
I HAVE NOT WASHED MY HANDS SINCE THE FIRST BUFFET.
TODAY'S SPECIAL IS A LARGE MAN AT HIGH SPEED.
OUT OF THE WAY! THE DESSERT CART IS LEAVING!
I SMELL GARLIC BREAD. I AM COMING FOR IT. YOU ARE IN THE WAY.
THE BUFFET NEVER CLOSES. NEITHER DO MY PANTS.
LOOK OUT. I CANNOT TURN. I CAN ONLY GO.
I CANNOT SEE MY FEET. I HAVE NOT SEEN THEM SINCE SCHOOL.
BELLY FIRST. ALWAYS BELLY FIRST.
I AM ROLLING IN HOT. AND GREASY.
THIS APRON HAS SEEN THINGS. MOSTLY SAUSAGE.
SECONDS! THIRDS! FOURTHS! YOU!
I CAME FOR THE SHRIMP. I STAYED FOR THE VIOLENCE.
THE EARLY BIRD SPECIAL IS A BELLY TO THE FACE.
WIDE LOAD! WIDE LOAD COMING THROUGH!
I ATE BEFORE THIS. I WILL EAT AFTER THIS. I AM EATING NOW.
MY STOMACH IS A BLACK HOLE. MY BELLY IS A WRECKING BALL.
STAND BACK. I HAD THE BEANS.
SALAD BAR? I DO NOT KNOW HER.
I AM THE ONLY CHEF WHO TASTES EVERYTHING. TWICE.
I HAVE A BRISKET IN MY POCKET. JUST IN CASE.
WHO TOOK THE LAST DINNER ROLL? WAS IT YOU? IT WAS YOU.
THE KITCHEN IS ON FIRE. SO IS MY HEARTBURN.
MY HEARTBURN IS A WEAPON.
TIME TO PUT ON MY STRETCHY PANTS. THEY ARE ALREADY ON.
I WILL FLATTEN YOU LIKE A PANCAKE. THEN I WILL EAT A PANCAKE.
THE BUFFET HAS A NO RUNNING SIGN. I CANNOT READ.
I NEED A RUNNING START. I HAVE BEEN RUNNING SINCE TUESDAY.
THE MEAT SWEATS ARE KICKING IN.
I SWEAT GRAVY. YOU WILL SLIP.
I BROUGHT MY OWN TUPPERWARE FOR YOUR REMAINS.
ALL YOU CAN EAT MEANS ALL YOU CAN EAT. INCLUDING YOU.
MY HAT IS TALL. MY HUNGER IS TALLER.
I EAT FIVE MEALS A DAY. THIS IS MEAL SIX.
THE CHEF RECOMMENDS: RUN.
HOT PLATE! HOT PLATE! I AM THE HOT PLATE!
I SAT ON A CAKE ON THE WAY HERE. IT WAS WORTH IT.
GRAVY TRAIN, LEAVING THE STATION. IT IS ME. I AM THE TRAIN.
I AM WEARING A BIB. IT IS NOT FOR ME.
